JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Namadi Hosts 19 Northern States Budget Commissioners for Zonal Food Systems Transformation Review
KANO STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Yusuf Establishes KASSTOWA for Small Towns Water & Sanitation; Initiates Plant Overhauls

KWARA STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov. AbdulRazaq Inaugurates Institute of Contemporary African Arts and Films (ICAAF) with Fela Exhibition

DELTA STATE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Oborevwori Extends Retirement Age for Skilled Health Professionals to 65 Years

ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.8): Zamfara Develops Demographic Dividend Roadmap; Receives NEC Polio Eradication Advocacy Team
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Sule Inspects Police Secondary School Gudi as Project Reaches 90% Completion
KADUNA STATE (PSI 7.5): Gov. Sani Advocates Inter-Agency Collaboration at Crisis Communication Symposium
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.4): Gov. Eno Urges Youth Reinvention and Value Addition at Ibom Ignite Conference 2026
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. Inuwa Yahaya Mourns Five Siblings Killed in School-Bound Tricycle-Tanker Crash
OYO STATE (PSI 7.0): Oyo State Government Completes Reconstruction of Oja Agbe Market in Iseyin LGA

LAGOS (PSI 9.4): Hosted AFRIDEX 2026 unveiling a 3D-printed uncrewed vessel; COWLSO Project 4.0 provided special education gear across IBILE divisions; LASEMA managed an Ijegun building collapse search and cleared road/rail obstructions.

BAYELSA (PSI 8.9): Gov Diri inspected the digital BEMSAS emergency dispatch center equipped with push-to-talk radios and digital tablets, along with expanded hemodialysis, CT scan, and X-ray facilities at BMUTH.

ABIA (PSI 8.8): Gov Otti commissioned internal asphalt roads, a resurfaced parade ground, swimming pool, and 10-unit officers' transit quarters at NNCAF Owerrinta, proposing an Azumini Naval Base for the planned seaport.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.6): Health Ministry activated Ebola surveillance and isolation facilities at PSSH/JUTH; Gov Mutfwang swore in Special Advisers, condemned the fresh Gyero village attack, and reinforced Operation Rainbow.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.6): Trained 34 health workers in Ikom on Ebola IPC/WASH; partnered with NCDC on One Health veterinary surveillance; and inspected Agrim International FZE condom factory in Calabar EPZ.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.5): Gov Namadi hosted Budget Commissioners from 19 Northern States and FAO for a 3-day Food Systems Transformation review, emphasizing preventive nutrition and the Masaki Programme.
KANO (PSI 8.5): Established KASSTOWA under Ag MD Engr Danbatta, posted 9 Sit-In Directors, and initiated pipeline and generator overhauls at Kiru, Tudun Wada, and Karaye water plants.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.4): Deputy Gov Farauta announced Adamawa's pledge to allocate 26% of budget to education and partnered with EIDU to train 80+ master trainers for 80,000 basic digital learners.
EDO (PSI 8.3): Edo Tourism Agency signed a ₦200m 36-month MoU with Owl Global Synergy; Akoko-Edo LGA assured NSCDC/NOA office renovations; and Gov Okpebholo pledged resources to upgrade EBS.
KWARA (PSI 8.2): Gov AbdulRazaq commissioned the Visual Arts Centre (ICAAF) in Ilorin, launching an international exhibition on Fela Anikulapo-Kuti in partnership with JCAA.
ANAMBRA (PSI 8.2): Gov Soludo advocated production-focused economic reforms and local Akwete textiles at the 32nd NES in Abuja, revealing Anambra reduced out-of-school rates from 2.5% to 0.25%.
DELTA (PSI 8.0): Gov Oborevwori approved extending retirement age from 60 to 65 years and service length from 35 to 40 years for 26 cadres of clinical health professionals in state hospitals.

EBONYI (PSI 7.8): 100 Ebonyi selected youths departed Abakaliki on Oct 26 for NITT Zaria to undergo intensive mechanical heavy-duty equipment operations and safety training under Gov Nwifuru's sponsorship.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.8): Ministry of Budget held a 5-day workshop supported by UNFPA to build a Demographic Dividend Roadmap; Ministry of Health received NEC Polio Committee led by Dr. Gloria Ahmed.
NASARAWA (PSI 7.6): Gov Abdullahi Sule inspected progress at the Police Secondary School Gudi, noting 90% completion ahead of planned academic takeoff.
KADUNA (PSI 7.5): Gov Uba Sani, represented by Info Commissioner Maiyaki, opened the 2nd National Crisis Communication Symposium, highlighting collaborative security across 8 volatile LGAs.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.4): Gov Umo Eno addressed the Ibom Ignite Conference 2026, challenging youths to reinvent thought processes, acquire skills, and deliver high-value branded services.
GOMBE (PSI 7.2): Gov Inuwa Yahaya expressed deep sorrow over the tragic death of 5 siblings in a tricycle-water tanker collision, urging motorists to observe traffic safety rules.
OYO (PSI 7.0): Completed and reconstructed Oja Agbe Market in Iseyin LGA under the Rural Access and Agricultural Marketing Project (RAAMP).
